headline: Jimmy Fallon Reacts to Karoline Leavitt’s White House Exit
context: The “Tonight Show” host said President Trump had been surprised by the press secretary’s decision to step down. “She was like, ‘I wanted to wait for a good time but there hasn’t been one, so.’”
